messages:
Liam: FYI, AcmeHealth reported they can't view audit logs in Console nor via the /v1/audit/logs API. They see a 403 with "retention_entitlement_missing". Repro steps below.

Liam: Repro (from their environment):
1) Console -> Compliance -> Audit logs -> shows "No access" banner
2) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <user-token>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs?org=acme-123"

Liam: Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "message": "missing entitlement: audit.read.retention_entitlement",
  "code": "retention_entitlement_missing",
  "trace_id": "tr-8f7a2b"
}
```

Sofia: @Liam can you paste the org id and the user role they're signing in with (SSO group)? also any tenant-id or Okta group id would help.

Liam: Org: acme-123, Okta group name: Acme_Auditors, user role shows as "analyst" in our system. They said they were previously able to query logs last month.

Priya: This smells like an entitlement mapping issue — either the retention entitlement wasn't granted when we onboarded them or the SSO group mapping changed. Usually returns 403 with that code when audit:retention scope isn't present.

Priya: Quick workaround (if customer ok): create a temporary org-level API key scoped to "audit:read" and share with their security admin. That avoids changing SSO while we debug. Need approval from Liam/customer first.

Liam: Customer approved temporary key. I created key-REDACTED and tested — console still blocked but API with key works for read in limited mode.

Liam: Entitlement service log excerpt (sanitized):
```
[2026-02-10T14:02:11Z] TRACE tr-8f7a2b check_entitlements org=acme-123 user=svc-acme-auditor result=deny reason=missing:entitlement(audit.retention) src=entitlement-service
```

Priya: @Marta can you check ad-sync / group mapping? My hypothesis: Okta group was renamed (Acme_Auditors -> Acme_Auditors_2026) and our mapping uses group ID not name OR the mapping table didn't backfill after rename.

Marta: Looking. I can see ad-sync job ran at 02:00 and returned a non-fatal error for acme-123: "group_id mismatch for Acme_Auditors". There's a small regression in the rename handling we shipped in ad-sync v1.4.2. Will patch mapping logic and re-run sync + backfill entitlements for affected orgs. ETA ~2 hours once I have PR merged.

Jared: Do we have a product/regression note on whether retention entitlements differ by plan? Customer expects retention access as part of their enterprise plan. If mapping bug cost them data access we should prioritize. Also need to notify CS about retention windows for Acme. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/audit-logs#retention (internal link).

Priya: Confirmed Acme-123 should have enterprise retention entitlements per onboarding record. This is straight up mapping/regression, not a purchase issue.

Liam: I've informed the customer: temporary admin-key workaround in place, they will rotate after fix. Raised ticket SUP-2026-1187 and noted ETA ~2h for permanent fix.

auth-bot: Change request CR-2026-440 created by Marta. Patch branch: github.com/redwood/ad-sync@fix/okta-rename. Auto-run: entitlement-backfill job queued.

Marta: Patch submitted, CI passing. I'm re-running the backfill now for acme-123 (job id bf-5532). I'll post results when complete.

escalations-bot: Noted. Alert created to monitor 403:retention_entitlement_missing spikes -> alert id A-9042.

Sofia: Follow-ups: 1) Update internal KB: SSO group rename checklist (add step to validate group IDs after rename). 2) Ramp up detection for missing entitlement errors. 3) Send short note to CS + legal about incident and retention assurances.

Liam: Closing loop with customer. Will update SUP-2026-1187 when backfill finishes.

Marta: Backfill completed for acme-123. Entitlement service now returns allow for audit.retention. Re-tested via API and console — customer confirmed they can view logs. Rolling the fix to prod ad-sync cluster now.

Liam: Customer confirmed access restored and will rotate temp key. Marking issue resolved on our side. :tada:

Sofia: Great, please add a post-incident note to /incidents and include timeline + root cause (Okta group rename handling regressed). Also add a short unit-test for group rename case in ad-sync.

Priya: Nice work. We'll follow up on a permanent alert for entitlement drift and add proactive scan for orgs with any missing expected entitlements.

Liam: Adding final note to ticket: resolution steps, temporary workaround, CR reference, and customer confirmation.
